player.note: QA-only successful native-Canvas path; the original player module is unchanged. The full same-folder candidate only relocates the original direct/legacy read and bounds/core block after armed rendering and colour composition, before metadata/frame spreads. The installer permits the candidate only when both own directAlphaReadback and verifyAlphaReadback flags are false; direct use of the candidate class is unsupported. Direct/verification modes, custom methods and changed owners use the whole original raster. Successful colour/body/bounds/contour equivalence requires separate actual quality evidence. Universal exception/order equivalence is not claimed: a deferred body-read error follows armed/compositor work, and an armed/compositor error can occur before that read. An already-started candidate is never retried through the original. Critical Canvas methods and ink write accessors are checked without invoking custom getters. Mutation of global ImageData/HTMLCanvas accessors or Three render-graph prototypes/callbacks is outside this native-successful-path contract. Original owned assets/scene callbacks must not mutate the frozen body canvas during the call; no per-frame whole-scene traversal certifies arbitrary foreign callbacks. No clocks, poses, skins, model data, assets or saves are advanced here. verify=true is quality-only Aoriginal/Bdeferred/Aoriginal, with six GL renders instead of two plus six explicit native Canvas captures; it returns the final original output and is never a performance pass. Whole-scene A/A quality gates remain independent. Source FNV guards are consumer guards, not cryptographic provenance. No caller GPU or asset resource is owned or disposed.

performance.note: Predeclared before measurement: total preparation+40callbacks+finalDrain at least3% lower than fasterA; first callback and all four steady30 callback median/p95/max/sum no worse than eitherA, plus40/41 p95/max no worse. Native success-path quality, literal Game, usage without fallbacks, cleanup and strict whole AA/AB/BA are required. Same original fullRGBA read and original GL draw count remain. Single bracket is diagnostic, injected tests never accepted, no automatic adoption/FPS/memory claim.

note: Explicit own-data playerDeferredRead:true and qa-player-deferred-read=1: fresh owned unprimed original/deferred/original player arms, no GPU pass or new textures. B relocates only the original body Canvas fullRGBA read and pure bounds/core calculations to after armed GL rendering and colour Canvas composition, before metadata getters. The unchanged pre-weapon bodyCanvas snapshot supplies original RGBA and contour. This changes readback scheduling, not frame count or animation. Direct/verify and unsupported or replaced methods fall back to original and block acceptance. Successful native Canvas paths are the scope; native read failures can occur after more drawing in B, so universal exceptional side-effect ordering is not certified. All work and installer reporting stay inside callbacks. Predeclared total preparation+40callbacks+finalDrain must improve3%; first callback, steady30 median/p95/max/sum and40/41 p95/max must not regress against either original. Strict whole AA/AB/BA, literal Game and ownership cleanup remain required. Verify-only mode adds same-context original/candidate/original raster draws at each already-computed frozen pose and strict fullcolour/bodyRGBA/metadata comparison; no ticks or selection calls are added. These extra reads/draws make its timing ineligible as performance evidence; it cannot override the separate final wholeCanvas gate. No default adoption, FPS or peak-memory claim. 8851 genuine-memory QA only. Fresh owned Renderer/Art/native player and initial max-three-model NPC preparation per original/manual/original arm. Original on-demand species loads remain enabled; actual runtime model/pending maxima are reported. Main ready records are borrowed by identity and never loaded, masked or released through a mutating path. Forty fixed .12-second catch-up callbacks include their first draw; batch-eight rAF yields are reported separately. This is a renderer combat harness without app HUD, audio or persistence, not presented FPS. Certification and lifecycle wrappers are inside render timing in every arm; no Canvas-stage, native-stage or frame-cost observer is installed. Literal per-frame checkpoint/effects/motion/commands/events and both RNG states are compared outside timers. Final whole-canvas readback and PNG export follow the measured loop. Existing twelve-state/two-selected-cell pixel QA is separate evidence, not proof for every source frame. Shared URL decode caches and the live product caches remain resident; fresh instances do not imply cold driver/URL caches. Owned native pending promises are followed through late success/failure for retirement. A failed player Promise.all can have unobservable sibling requests; that failure is explicitly cleanup-unproven rather than called complete. Timings are CPU call wall, not GPU duration or peak memory. No product optimization is adopted by this utility.
